meta.start_reference: Week 1 = plan kickoff (real dates TBD until program re-baseline confirms)

workstreams.name: Leadership & Sponsorship
workstreams.objective: Sponsor visibly active with scripted moments at every major milestone.

workstreams.name: Communications
workstreams.objective: Awareness runway live with a working 48h review gate.

workstreams.name: Change Network
workstreams.objective: Champion network nominated, onboarded, and meeting monthly.

workstreams.name: Training
workstreams.objective: Training strategy and curriculum locked; build underway ahead of go-live.

workstreams.name: Readiness & Adoption Measurement
workstreams.objective: Baseline pulse fielded; adoption metrics defined before go-live.

workstreams.name: Sustainment
workstreams.objective: Handoff structure in place from day one; plan survives its authors.

activities.title: Confirm sponsor and sender architecture
activities.description: Agree who opens, signs, and approves each comms tier; sponsor opens awareness comms, OCM lead signs the body.
activities.done_test: Sponsor has approved the page and the first comm uses it

activities.title: Leadership alignment session on change narrative
activities.description: 60-min session: why now, what changes, guardrails (reinforce timeline, quality over speed).
activities.done_test: Session held; guardrails documented and circulated

activities.title: Sponsor milestone message at build sign-off
activities.description: Short progress note from the sponsor to senior leadership when the build milestone signs off.
activities.done_test: Message sent within 3 days of milestone sign-off

activities.title: Stand up the comms review gate
activities.description: 48h approver gate for org-wide comms; approvers named per the sender architecture.
activities.done_test: First comm passes the gate inside 48h

activities.title: What's Changing Ep.1 — org-wide awareness
activities.description: First awareness email; contextual, not tied to a specific go-live date.
activities.done_test: Gate cleared and email sent; champions saw it first

activities.title: BU change-impact preview — Retail
activities.description: First targeted BU comm, seeded from the CIA's Retail impacts; Retail director cosigns.
activities.done_test: Gate cleared; sent to Retail audience
linked_impacts: Automated replenishment replacing manual reorder spreadsheets

activities.title: Town hall planning (execution staggered ahead of go-live)
activities.description: Plan the town hall series; execution lands ahead of go-live, not stranded months early.
activities.output: Town hall plan with per-audience windows
activities.done_test: Plan reviewed at sponsor touchpoint and dates parked as ranges

activities.title: Nominate change champions
activities.description: Leaders nominate 1-2 champions per department; influence over seniority.
activities.done_test: Every in-scope BU has at least one named champion

activities.title: Champion onboarding session
activities.description: Role, time commitment, feedback loop; champions see impacted-audience comms before they go out.
activities.done_test: Session held; monthly touchpoint booked as a cadence

activities.title: First champion feedback synthesis
activities.description: Collect what champions hear on the floor; feed themes to comms and training.
activities.done_test: Memo reviewed at standup; at least one plan adjustment traced to it

activities.title: Training strategy locked (Gate 1)
activities.description: Modality blend and rollout order, worked backward from go-live so training lands ahead of it.

activities.title: Curriculum locked (Gate 2)
activities.description: Objectives, modules, role-to-course mapping from the CIA training layer.
activities.done_test: Role mapping covers every impacted role in the CIA

activities.title: Stable-topic material build begins
activities.description: Start with modules not dependent on late build decisions; defer volatile modules.
activities.done_test: Two stable modules drafted and reviewed

activities.title: Baseline readiness pulse
activities.description: Short pulse to impacted audiences; sets the baseline for wave-over-wave comparison.
activities.done_test: Response rate reported; baseline scores filed

activities.title: Define adoption metrics
activities.description: Usage, behavior, and outcome metrics agreed before go-live; no invented targets.
activities.done_test: Each metric has a source system and an owner

activities.title: Pulse #2 + readout
activities.description: Second pulse; compare to baseline, feed course corrections into the roll-forward.

activities.title: Stand up the handoff file
activities.description: Start the handoff doc skeleton now (anchor timeline, decisions log, open items) — not in week 12.
activities.output: Handoff doc skeleton in the shared folder
activities.done_test: Skeleton exists with the seven standard sections

activities.title: 90-day refresh & roll-forward
activities.description: Status pass on every activity; re-baseline the next window; update the handoff doc.
activities.done_test: Every activity has a status; next window drafted

cadences.name: Sponsor touchpoint
cadences.purpose: Keep the sponsor active; tee up sponsor moments.

cadences.name: Change champions touchpoint
cadences.purpose: Brief champions first; collect floor-level feedback.

cadences.name: SteerCo OCM slot
cadences.purpose: Escalations and readiness status on the program's existing forum.

cadences.name: Monthly plan refresh
cadences.purpose: Status pass + roll the window forward — the playbook stays alive.

escalation.trigger: Day-to-day sequencing, wording, and owner swaps within a workstream.
Any comms slip > 1 week; any champion coverage gap; guardrail exceptions.
Any change to publicly communicated timeline; budget or scope impacts on OCM.

items.item: Why-this-version narrative (what changed since last baseline)
Anchor timeline named and reconciled to the canonical program schedule
Change log vs. prior version, numbered
Open items needing recipient input, phrased as questions
What did NOT change (carries forward untouched)
Backup coverage named; review gates still apply when owner is out

open_questions: Who signs training comms — is there a named training sponsor yet?
Confirm the per-audience town hall windows once the schedule firms up.
